content.rendered:
Hello SCS families!

Welcome to the 2024-2025 school year! In preparation for a fantastic year ahead, we are providing a Back to School newsletter with important information you won’t want to miss. Included are things for you to do before the school year, as well as important upcoming event details. Check it out using the link below!

Click to view the Back to School Newsletter
